title: Complex distribution and velocity field of molecular gas in NGC 1316 as revealed by the Morita Array of ALMA
question: What are the distribution, total mass and velocity field of molecular gas in the cD/radio galaxy NGC 1316, what is its origin (inflow or outflow), and how does it interact with the nuclear jet?

evidence.quote: given the literature data of dust mass (cite: Draine:2007aa) and the upper limit of H i mass (cite: Horellou:2001aa)
given the literature data of dust mass (cite: Draine:2007aa) and the upper limit of H i mass (cite: Horellou:2001aa)

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image 7M data, combine with TP
recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, tclean mosaic cube, feather with TP, primary beam correction

recipe.goal: Detect CO emission and make moment maps
recipe.method: SoFiA source finding with noise normalisation, smoothing kernels, 4 sigma threshold, friends-of-friends merging, reliability cuts; moment 1/2 blanked below 0.9 Jy/beam km/s
key_parameters: merging radius 2 pixels, 3 channels; min size 3 pixels/channels; integrated S/N>3; dilation 2 pixels, 1 channel

recipe.method: Sum moment-0 flux in a box, convert Jy/beam to K via Rayleigh-Jeans, apply X_CO and helium factor 1.36; error from noise map
assumptions: Milky-Way X_CO = 2.0e20 cm^-2 (K km/s)^-1; distance 20.8 Mpc

recipe.goal: Characterise velocity field with PV cuts and compare with Keck ionized gas
recipe.method: Moment-1/2 maps and position-velocity cuts of CO; Keck/LRIS long-slit spectra PV maps compared at same PA
key_parameters: LRIS slit PA 158.56 deg, 1.0" slit, velocity accuracy ~100 km/s

recipe.goal: Estimate relaxation timescale and GDR/H2-HI ratios
recipe.method: t_relax = t_dyn/epsilon with literature t_dyn and epsilon; GDR and H2/HI from literature dust and HI limit

evidence.quote: The total molecular gas mass is estimated to be $(5.62 \pm 0.53)\times 10^8$ M$_\odot$
a weak and narrow CO emission is detected with a peak intensity of $26.8$ mK at $\sim 1720$ km s$^{-1}$
The velocity difference between the NW Shell and the SE Blob ($\sim 400$ km s$^{-1}$
the obtained GDR and H$_2$/H i ratio of the dust patches are respectively $\sim 28$ and $\gtrsim 5.6$
$t_{\rm relax}$ is estimated to be $8\times10^8$ yr
The velocity dispersion of the molecular gas is roughly in the range of $20-50$ km s$^{-1}$ at kpc-resolution.
